title: Have you watched a movie?
content: Past the food courts it gets a bit empty just white curved walls and tiles. I know there were posters inset into the walls but I was not able to see them. The food court becomes so sparse yet there are games interspersed and a merry go round that is not in operation. There is a single store I typically go into here which is why I am here. A sort of magazine shop you would find at an airport but unfolds into a fairly large three story book shop and record shop. Has anyone been in the theatre(s)?
